gallery.blurb: A maze carved by a recursive backtracker with the carving head visible, then solved by a glowing breadth-first flood that reveals the shortest path, then a new maze.
gallery.prompt: A maze carved by a recursive backtracker with the carving head visible, then solved by a glowing breadth-first flood that reveals the shortest path, then a new maze. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
